svg.title: One track. Two frames.
svg.desc: Four common-start runners · speeds 1, 2, 3, 4 · reference R2 · t = 1/3 Runners start together. Here R1 and R4 coincide, while R2 and R3 are each lonely. Concentric rings preserve coincident identities. The amber arc marks distance < 1/4, with hollow equality endpoints; blue shows a shortest distance. Phase increases clockwise from the top. Subtracting the reference speed preserves distances; changing the reference changes whose loneliness is checked.
